listing.name: Turok: Rage Wars (PaxDino)
listing.summary: Attach an independently permitted, prepared PaxDino Windows player for Turok: Rage Wars using your own exact supported ROM. Upstream owns ROM preparation and replacement; preserve the actual trwrecomp configuration/save root and component notices.

steps.title: Prepare the exact game upstream
steps.instruction: Use a complete player and components you are independently permitted to use, with your own Turok: Rage Wars ROM: USA version 1.0 .z64 SHA1 9F8CB190831945F6F707AA8C2B20E04FA4276795; the byte-swapped .n64 representation has SHA1 11C2DD51FFCECC5D8134CEC96FFCF9C44B15DB48. These SHA1 values identify the documented representation, not ownership or a signature. Upstream also accepts supported byte-order variants; do not apply a .z64 hash to differently ordered bytes. Finish the upstream Load ROM flow before attachment and preserve the independent original. No ROM, BIOS, helper or game is obtained or executed by this guide.

steps.title: Keep the matching Windows package
steps.instruction: The inspected official Windows ZIP contains the AMD64 PaxDino.exe native player. Keep its complete extracted directory, assets, renderer/runtime libraries and notices together. The player runs the recompiled game through its linked runtime within the selected process; do not select a ROM, build tool, AppImage or another title’s executable. Source and PE observations do not establish Windows gameplay or dependency resolution.

steps.title: Attach the prepared native player
steps.instruction: Select PaxDino.exe, set its complete extracted package directory as working directory and leave arguments empty. Review that exact intent and request Play separately. Use the upstream player UI to choose/start the already prepared game. Complete missing-ROM setup outside the attached attempt before retrying. Quit the actual game normally; forced termination is not a save-flush or recovery guarantee.

steps.title: Preserve the actual data root
steps.instruction: The selected source sets program_id to trwrecomp; its pinned Frontend normally uses %LOCALAPPDATA%/trwrecomp on Windows. An existing portable.txt in the working directory instead selects that directory. Keep the complete active root, imported ROM, saves, settings, input profiles and mods, plus any existing external paths. This guide creates no marker, moves no files and does not infer compatibility from another game. Keep Controller Pak data, per-player controls and any existing external custom-music folder. Other Turok games, co-op and multiplayer compatibility are not qualified.

steps.title: Retain the exact component terms
steps.instruction: Preserve the project GPLv3 notice, title-specific authored patches, N64ModernRuntime, RT64 and all dependency notices. This source pins the unchanged official RecompFrontend base b1a1477c6556aeb7ed45defbfb5924f721efebc1 covered by the existing official license follow-up; that correspondence does not license unrelated forks or original game code/assets. The selected source uses Exo 2, Noto Emoji and promptfont with separate SIL Open Font License notices. Keep those notices and use only components you are independently permitted to use.

steps.title: Maintain the external copy explicitly
steps.instruction: Quit the game before upstream replacement, ROM changes, mods or data operations. Preserve independent recovery copies and review/relink changed executable bytes. Keep Controller Pak data, per-player controls and any existing external custom-music folder. Other Turok games, co-op and multiplayer compatibility are not qualified. Upstream playability and platform reports remain upstream claims; no installed-app, campaign, save/reload or Supported acceptance is asserted. Removing registration preserves external files; managed installation, updates, rollback, backup and removal remain unavailable.

warnings: Use the exact supported Turok: Rage Wars ROM and retain its actual data root; this guide does not qualify other titles, save compatibility or native gameplay.
